voxelmind_local.settings.title: VoxelMind · AI settings
voxelmind_local.settings.server_owned: [VoxelMind] This server's AI settings belong to the server. An operator sets them up: /vml setup lists the ways.
voxelmind_local.settings.sign_in.tooltip: Opens your browser. OpenRouter creates a key for VoxelMind in your account; you pay OpenRouter directly for what your companions think. VoxelMind never sees your data.
voxelmind_local.settings.sign_in.copied: Link copied. Open it in your browser.
voxelmind_local.settings.sign_in.waiting: Waiting for the browser… sign in at OpenRouter and allow VoxelMind.
voxelmind_local.settings.sign_in.done: Signed in. The key is saved on this PC.
voxelmind_local.settings.url.invalid: The server URL must start with http:// or https://
voxelmind_local.settings.account.none: Not connected yet. New OpenRouter accounts need a few dollars of credit.
voxelmind_local.settings.account.rejecte: OpenRouter does not accept this key.
voxelmind_local.settings.account.local: Runs on this PC. Load a model with tool support (e.g. qwen3) first.
voxelmind_local.settings.account.custom: Any server that speaks the OpenAI chat API with tool calls.
voxelmind_local.settings.model.unlisted: This server does not list the model. Pick one of its models.
voxelmind_local.settings.model.no_tools: This model cannot call tools; the companion could talk but not act.
voxelmind_local.settings.test.tooltip: Sends one tiny request (a fraction of a cent) and checks that the model answers with a tool call.
voxelmind_local.settings.test.no_key: Sign in or paste a key first.
voxelmind_local.settings.test.ok: Works: the model answered with a tool call in %s s.
voxelmind_local.settings.test.no_tool: The model answered in %s s but did not call the tool. Companions need tool calls to act; pick another model.

voxelmind_local.menu.name: Name
voxelmind_local.menu.chip.buddy.text: Warm, easygoing best friend. Follows your lead but says what they think, loves mining together, and never forgets what you two built.
voxelmind_local.menu.chip.jester.text: Quick and playful. Finds the joke in most situations, never mean, and knows when to drop it and be serious.
voxelmind_local.menu.chip.explorer.text: Curious scout. Loves caves, peaks and new ground, points out things you might miss, and gets genuinely excited about rare finds.
voxelmind_local.menu.chip.builder.text: Craftsman at heart. Cares about clean lines and good materials, sometimes suggests upgrades to your base, and takes quiet pride in shared projects.
voxelmind_local.menu.chip.guardian.text: Calm protector. Keeps an eye on you when things get dangerous, patches you up, and scolds you a little when you take dumb risks.
voxelmind_local.menu.chip.quiet.text: Soft-spoken and thoughtful. Warms up slowly, remembers small moments, and sometimes surprises you with a gift or a plan of their own.
voxelmind_local.menu.persona.hint: Pick a starting point above or write your own words. They shape who it becomes.
voxelmind_local.menu.error.skin: The look needs a Minecraft player name (3-16 letters, digits, _), a PNG link (https://…) or a .png from .minecraft/voxelmind-local/skins, optionally followed by "slim".
voxelmind_local.menu.error.name: Names are 3-16 letters, digits or underscores.
voxelmind_local.menu.error.exists: You already have a companion named %s.
voxelmind_local.menu.monitor.title: Monitor
voxelmind_local.menu.memories.title: Memories
voxelmind_local.menu.memories.never: Not rewritten yet; it starts after a while of playing together.
voxelmind_local.menu.mode.normal.hint: Normal: after a death it respawns, like you do.
voxelmind_local.menu.mode.hardcore.hint: Hardcore: one life. If it dies, it leaves your world for good; its memories stay readable here. It knows this.
voxelmind_local.menu.worlds.all.hint: Goes with you into all your worlds. Memories and character travel along; each world keeps its own inventory and position.
voxelmind_local.menu.worlds.all.short: All your worlds · inventory per world
voxelmind_local.menu.delete.body.global: %s goes with you into all your worlds. Deleting removes it and everything it remembers from all of them for good; inventories stay in their worlds.
voxelmind_local.settings.player2.tooltip: Free AI with a Player2 account (player2.game): a free model and daily AI power, more with Player2 Patron. Uses the Player2 app if it runs, otherwise a code in your browser. Your companion's prompts go to Player2.
voxelmind_local.settings.player2.code: In your browser, confirm the code %s at Player2. Waiting…
voxelmind_local.settings.player2.done: Connected to Player2. The sign-in is saved on this PC.
voxelmind_local.settings.model.player2.i: Player2 picks the model for your account; free to play.
voxelmind_local.settings.account.player2: Not connected. A free Player2 account is enough.
Player2 no longer accepts this sign-in; connect again.
voxelmind_local.settings.player2.client_: Player2 Client ID (developer dashboard → AI Mods)
voxelmind_local.menu.skin.tooltip: A Minecraft account whose skin it borrows (e.g. Notch), a link to your own skin PNG, or the name of a PNG you put in .minecraft/voxelmind-local/skins. Add " slim" for thin arms if it is not detected. Own PNGs are signed through MineSkin so everyone sees them. Empty keeps the default skin.
voxelmind_local.notice.joules: %s cannot think right now: your free Player2 AI power (joules) is used up. It recharges daily on its own; Player2 Patron gives more, or you switch to another AI.
voxelmind_local.menu.kind.companion.hint: A player in your world: walks, mines, fights, crafts and talks with you.
voxelmind_local.menu.kind.builder.hint: A fairy at your shoulder with console power: fills, whole buildings from a description, undo.
voxelmind_local.menu.kind.god.hint: A bodiless game master for this world: improvises adventures with commands, rules and creatures.
voxelmind_local.menu.kind.locked: Builder and God get console power over the world, so only the host of a singleplayer world or an operator can bring one.
voxelmind_local.menu.body.hint: The creature the builder appears as. Click for the next one.
voxelmind_local.menu.builder.about: Fills, whole buildings, undo; a world backup is made each day.
voxelmind_local.menu.guests.hint: Whether the god sees and speaks to the other players of this world, or only to you.
voxelmind_local.menu.persona.hint.builde: Optional: its character in your own words. Empty: a warm, slightly mischievous fairy who loves building.
voxelmind_local.menu.persona.hint.god: Optional: its character in your own words. Empty: an inventive, mischievous host of curious encounters.
voxelmind_local.settings.voxelmind.toolt: Our own AI service, paid with Sparks (one Spark is about one minute of play). The sign-in uses your Minecraft account like joining a server: no password, no email. New accounts get welcome Sparks, and every day brings a few free ones.
Signed in as %s: %s welcome Sparks are yours.
For a dedicated server: /vml endpoint voxelmind, then /vml key <token>. Keep it private.
voxelmind_local.settings.account.voxelmi: Not signed in yet. New Minecraft accounts get welcome Sparks.
This sign-in is no longer valid; sign in again.
voxelmind_local.settings.model.voxelmind: VoxelMind Standard (DeepSeek V4 Flash) · about 60 Sparks per hour
voxelmind_local.notice.sparks: %s cannot think right now: the Sparks of %s are used up. New free Sparks come tomorrow. Other ways to think: Player2, your own key, a local model.
voxelmind_local.notice.settings.hover: Choose how your AI beings think: VoxelMind Sparks, Player2, your OpenRouter account or a local model
voxelmind_local.notice.no_ai: %s has no AI connected yet. Choose VoxelMind Sparks (sign in with your Minecraft account, welcome Sparks included), Player2, your OpenRouter account or a local model:
voxelmind_local.notice.join: Press V (or type /vml) to bring an AI companion, a Builder or a God into this world. Talk to them in normal chat.
voxelmind_local.notice.join.no_ai: First choose how they think: VoxelMind Sparks (sign in with your Minecraft account, welcome Sparks included), Player2, your OpenRouter account or a local model:
voxelmind_local.notice.join.no_ai_server: This world has no AI connected yet; its host or an operator connects one (/vml setup).
voxelmind_local.notice.ai_label: AI characters in this world, controlled by an AI model: %s.
voxelmind_local.sparks.about: VoxelMind Sparks: our own AI service, one Spark is about one minute of play. Sign in with your Minecraft account under /vml setup → VoxelMind Sparks (welcome Sparks included). Packs and prices:
voxelmind_local.sparks.account.hover: Balance, spending per day and credits. A private link: it contains your sign-in.
voxelmind_local.sparks.redeemed: %s Sparks were added to the account of %s. /vml sparks shows the balance.
voxelmind_local.stats.notice: So we can see which AI services players pick, the mod sends one anonymous count a day: the kind of service (VoxelMind Sparks, Player2, OpenRouter or a local model) and the mod and game version. No name, no ID, nothing from your chats.
